data.gender_notes: Vishav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vishav is recorded with the meaning “All-pervading, Universal”. Vishav is a Hindu name meaning “All-pervading, Universal”. in_sanskrit.name: विशव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vishav is derived from the Sanskrit root 'vis' meaning 'all' and 'shav' meaning 'pervading' or 'present'. The name signifies the one who pervades or is present everywhere.

in_hindi.name: विशव
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Vishav in Hindi is transliterated as 'viśvāsapūrṇ'. The meaning of the name remains the same as in Sanskrit, signifying the one who pervades or is present everywhere.

in_tamil.name: விஷவ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of the name Vishav is 'viḍutal'. The meaning of the name is 'pervading' or 'all-pervading'. It is derived from the Tamil root 'viḍu' meaning 'pervade'.

in_telugu.name: విషవ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of the name Vishav is 'viśvadēśa'. The meaning of the name is 'Lord of all' or 'Ruler of the Universe'. It is derived from the Telugu roots 'viśva' meaning 'all' and 'dēśa' meaning 'lord' or 'ruler'.

in_marathi.name: Vishav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishav means one who pervades the entire universe. It is a name that signifies the expansive and inclusive nature of the universe itself. One who embodies this name is believed to have a deep understanding of the interconnectedness of all things and a profound wisdom that transcends individual experiences.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vishav means one who pervades the entire universe. It is a name that signifies the expansive and inclusive nature of the universe itself.
